source.notes: Matched native source and current resolver stack to the observed effect.

privacy.notes: Full images inspected. Names, servers, channels and previews are fictional. Avatars are generic. Native notification input records were copied and scrubbed before rendering.

visual.notes: Compared full frames and original-scale crops. The viewport and list positions are identical. Baseline and restoration hashes match.

annotation.notes: The outline points to the affected component without covering text or icons.

unrelatedComponents.notes: Header and list backgrounds change, including their translucent edges. Text and avatar colours do not change.

description.notes: Colours the Inbox background behind its header and notification rows.
